Native JavaScript API

Vivid Player integration guide

Mount project 1189 / product 3478 directly into a page, build client-owned Player controls, and keep Current config synchronized. No iframe is used.

1. Add a container and the SDK

The SDK creates the PlayCanvas canvas inside the selected element.

<div id="vivid-player-root" style="width:100%;height:720px"></div>
<script src="https://player.vivid3d.tech/cdn/vivid-player.js"></script>

2. Initialize the native player

let player = await window.initVividPlayer({
  container: "#vivid-player-root",
  idProject: "1189",
  idProduct: "3478",
  environment: "production",
  viewMode: "WebGL",
  shareable: true,
  playcanvasBaseUrl: window.location.origin + "/vivid-assets/"
});
shareable: true fixes the active product and removes Product selection. This demo uses a fixed-origin asset proxy because the current PlayCanvas export restricts browser origins.

3. Build Player controls from API data

function renderOptionButtons() {
  const options = player.getConfigOptions();

  options.forEach((option) => {
    option.variants.forEach((variant) => {
      const button = document.createElement("button");
      button.textContent = variant.label || variant.name;
      button.disabled = variant.selected;

      button.addEventListener("click", async () => {
        await player.setConfigOption(option.key, variant.value);
        renderOptionButtons();
        renderCurrentConfig();
      });
    });
  });
}
The RATIONAL product exposes five groups: Icombi Body, Stand, Fat Drain, Vent, and Open.

4. Display and synchronize Current config

function renderCurrentConfig() {
  document.querySelector("#config-output").textContent =
    JSON.stringify(player.getConfiguration(), null, 2);
}

player.on("configurationChanged", () => {
  renderOptionButtons();
  renderCurrentConfig();
});
Use getConfiguration() for the compact selection map. Use getSchema() when product metadata and normalized PlayCanvas configuration are also required.

5. Lifecycle

await player.fullscreen.toggle();

await player.destroy();
player = null;
Destroy the current instance before initializing another player in the same page. The working implementation is available in dist/index.html.
